title: Stop apologizing for the fire God put inside you. 🔥 They call you "too much" because they are intimidated by "real."
paragraphs: Stop apologizing for the fire God put inside you. 🔥 They call you "too much" because they are intimidated by "real."

Don't dim your light just because it blinds people who are used to living in the fake. Your intensity isn’t a flaw; it’s your weapon for the battlefield. The world doesn't need another carbon copy; it needs the authentic, Spirit-filled YOU.
Stand firm. You weren’t made to fit in. You were made to stand out.
⚔️ "If you belonged to the world, it would love you as its own. As it is, you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world. That is why the world hates you." — John 15:19
Drop a 🔥 if you are done being fake for the world. Follow my journey on the front lines 👉 @iamGospelWarrior
